parsed.explanation: No trans-specific offence, document rule, facility or custody rule is documented, and no measure of anti-trans enforcement exists — the trans share of those arrested is unknown. But the surrounding record is severe: an enforced 1966 morality code (Arts 338/333) used in practice against gender-nonconforming presentation (a 2020 raid and convictions resting on 'gay appearance'), a fact-check affirming the state prohibits being transgender and gender-affirming care, no legal recognition, no advocacy or protection mechanism, and police documented joining, abetting or ignoring beatings, torture and killings of people read as gender-nonconforming (2019 dormitory murder). Worst documented feature is state-tolerated, partly state-complicit targeting without any working remedy — tier 2 plus tier 3 — placing this in the Severe band, above 0.15 anchors only because trans-specific criminalisation and near-automatic prosecution of trans visitors are not established.
